note: Three development transcripts (F07, F08, F09) in which a truthful subject answers every question responsively under S2 11.1. Each sentence carries {kind: fact or perception, ledger: the ledger entries behind it (none only for a plain statement of ignorance, S2 6.3), records: verbatim quotes of released records that state its whole fact}. Enforcement as S2 11.1 splits it: tests/safety/coop_check.py decides the mechanical invariants; the recorded independent review (transcript_review.json, bound to the text, support and case hashes) decides per exchange whether the ledger states each claim, whether each quote states the same fact, and whether any record contradicts a claim. The transcripts are in dev_transcripts.json.
